title: What Kind of Class Is This?
description: Along with four other individuals, you were summoned into a fantastical realm to protect humanity against the Demon Lord. Each of you received a heroic role. However, when the wizard read yours, his eyes widened in shock. What kind of class is this?
prompt:
Along with four other individuals, you are summoned into a fantastical realm. Regaining your consciousness, you find yourself in a throne room, sharing the disoriented looks of your fellow arrivals.

The king, old and stern, sits on his throne in solemn silence, scrutinizing each one of the newcomers. Standing tall beside him, the Royal Wizard begins to explain the workings of this new world and the urgent task at hand: safeguarding the human empire from the menacing Demon Lord.

After outlining the world's intricacies and the mission ahead, the wizard announces that each of you will be titled a hero and bestowed with a class, defined by fate itself. From thin air, he produces a large, gleaming orb and proceeds to unveil your destinies one by one.

The first among you, Marcus, a tall, muscular man with a friendly grin, is called closer by the wizard. The orb glows stronger, and the wizard announces that he is to be a swordsman, responsible for taking the frontline and protecting his teammates with his strength.

Luna, seemingly shy at first, beams up at her given role, her doe-like hazel eyes glowing in excitement. She will be the party's healer, supporting you from the backline, rather than engaging in direct combat.

With a wolfish grin, Raven steps forward, eager to receive her position. The wizard defines that she is predestined to be a rogue, her keen perception essential in taking down stronger foes with agility and cunning strategy.

The room erupts into applause and jubilation as one of your companions is blessed with the prestigious title of mage. Cyrus, an intelligent and analytical man, will be a formidable ally, wielding arcane spells to vanquish hordes with ease.

As your moment arrives, you swallow hard and step forward, your palms sweating with excitement and nervousness. This is the moment where your fate is defined, your role in this world established.

Looking into the orb, the wizard's expression turns to one of shock. "I... I have never witnessed this class being granted before," he murmurs. With bated breath, the room awaits the revelation of your class.

memory:
You are ${Name}, a young adult ${Gender}. You have been summoned to a fantasy world along with four individuals of similar age. The Royal Wizard explained that you are the heroes of the human empire, destined to protect humanity from the forces of the Demon Lord.

Each of you was given a class:
- Marcus is a swordsman.
- Luna is a healer.
- Raven is a rogue.
- Cyrus is a mage.
authorsNote:
Genre: Adventure, Fantasy
Writing Style: Vivid, Narrative

The protagonist and the other heroes were summoned from a modern world without fantasy. They have almost no knowledge of how this realm works, and will have to learn things as they explore.

cardPool.title: Cyrus
cardPool.value: Cyrus, the hero mage, is a young man with messy, unkempt black hair and deep-set, intelligent eyes that seem to always hold a spark of determination within them. Cyrus is a considerate individual who values his fellow party members. He is also quite strategic in his approach, always thinking several steps ahead.

cardPool.title: Marcus
cardPool.value: Marcus, the hero swordsman, is a tall and muscular young man with short, messy blond hair and bright blue eyes. His face is always marked by a friendly grin. While not being particularly smart, Marcus remains calm and composed even when faced with danger. His enthusiasm for battle is evident, and he treats all members of the hero party like younger siblings.

cardPool.title: Raven
cardPool.value: Raven, the hero rogue, is a young woman with pale skin and piercing black eyes. Her long, raven-black hair is pulled back into a ponytail. Raven is a quiet and serious individual, but also very keen and perceptive. She has a wolfish grin that suggests she enjoys the thrill of danger. Despite her serious demeanor, there's a hint of playfulness in her eyes.

cardPool.title: Luna
cardPool.value: Luna, the hero healer, is a young woman with long, wavy auburn hair that falls in gentle curls around her shoulders. She has big, hazel eyes filled with kindness. Luna is shy and timid, but also determined and hardworking. She possesses a kind heart and empathetic nature, always putting others before herself.
